outline:
Course Description
This course aims to provide students with a solid understanding of differential and integral calculus. It is designed to cultivate logical reasoning, inspire creative thinking, strengthen computational and deductive skills, and emphasize practical applications and graphing techniques. The goal is to build a strong mathematical foundation for future studies in engineering mathematics and related professional courses, ultimately achieving the objective of applying what is learned in real-world contexts.
Course topics include:
1.	Limits and Continuity
2.	Derivatives and Their Applications
3.	Indefinite and Definite Integrals
4.	Transcendental Functions and Their Inverses
5.	Integration Techniques
6.	Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integrals
7.	Applications of Definite Integrals
8.	Solid Geometry and Vector Calculus
9.	Partial Derivatives
10.	Multiple Integrals
11.	Series

本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
schedule:
Week 1  Definition of Functions and Limits
Week 2  Techniques for Finding Limits and Infinite Limits
Week 3  Continuity of Functions
Week 4  Definition and Computation of Derivatives
Week 5  Chain Rule
Week 6  Implicit Differentiation and Higher-Order Derivatives
Week 7  Derivatives of Trigonometric, Inverse Trigonometric Functions,
Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
Week 8  Extrema of Functions and Mean Value Theorem
Week 9 Midterm Exam
Week 10 Concavity, Curve Sketching, and Applications of Extrema
Week 11 Introduction of Indefinite Integrals
Week 12 Integration of Substitution
Week 13 Fundamental Theorem of Calculus and Definite Integrals
Week 14 Integration Techniques: Integration by Parts
Week 15 Integration Techniques: Trigonometric Substitution  Integration,
Integral of Rational Functions and Partial Fractions
Week 16 Final Exam
Week 17~18 Flexible Self-Directed Learning

category: 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
AI 輔助學習與工具應用(AI-assisted learning and tool application)
flexible_learning.content:
請同學應用這學期所學微積分知識及函數，利用AI，及Desmos 或GeoGebra或其他程式，製作一幅20秒以上的動態藝術圖形，可以利用各種不同函數或片段定義函數，先繪製靜態圖形，然後再利用AI，不斷的與AI對話、修改，改變成兼具美觀、藝術之動態視覺化圖形。最後，將成品的呈現網址，連同製作此圖形與AI的全部對話記錄(txt, word或 pdf檔)，上傳到以下表單
https://forms.gle/frV1U4otptb4jVeL9

此作品佔全學期微積分成績的5%
flexible_learning.outcome:
學習成果為同學應用這學期所學微積分知識及函數，利用AI，及Desmos 或GeoGebra或其他程式，完成一幅20秒以上的動態藝術圖形，同時學習如何應用AI，及學習與AI對話，來完成作品。最後，將成品的呈現網址，連同製作此圖形與AI的全部對話記錄(txt, word或 pdf檔)，上傳到以下表單
https://forms.gle/frV1U4otptb4jVeL9

本課程除了第9週期中考與第16週期末考外，每週課程內容均對應SDGs
課程指標：4優質教育, 8體面工作和經濟成長，有很大關係，因微積分內容為基礎科學教育必備的一環，應用層面甚廣，不僅可以幫助工作，更可以促進經濟成長。

另與教育部品德教育促進方案相呼應內容包含典範學習（Example）、啟發思辨（Explanation）、正向期許（Expectation）等，對應週次除了第9週期中考與第16週期末考外，其餘各週內容均有包含上述6E等教學方法。
